content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial is for missing required prior authorization; retroactive authorization and peer-to-peer review are unavailable under this payer's rules. Eligibility, coding, and COB are valid, so correcting or resubmitting the claim would not address the denial. A formal medical-necessity appeal is available because a denial is on the table and can progress the claim without escalation or improperly billing the patient.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
